Package graph

Class AdjacencyListGraph

java.lang.Object
graph.AbstractGraph
graph.AdjacencyListGraph
All Implemented Interfaces:
Graph
public class AdjacencyListGraph extends AbstractGraph
Graph stored as an adjacency list with weights: for each vertex a map from neighbor to edge weight.
